chooseDescription: Choose how you want to start. The new skill is saved to the registry and added to this agent.
writeHint: Start from a blank page. Name it, describe it and write the steps.
uploadHint: Choose a SKILL.md file or a .zip, or drop a skill folder here.
importHint: Copy one or more skills from a public repository.
savedAndAdded: Create and add saves it to your skill registry and adds it to this agent.
